verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Connect offers an embedded onboarding component, API-based custom onboarding and identity verification. Nothing in the pack documents collecting a minimal set of information up front, deferring the rest until payout thresholds, or exposing per-seller requirements-due states. Custom API onboarding is a developer building block for constructing such a flow, not the tunable incremental-onboarding capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, onboarding friction is tunable — collect the minimum to start selling and gather the rest before payout thresholds, with clear requirements-due states per seller
